excerpts.text: page Copy page Send Vast.ai notification events to your own HTTPS endpoint for automation, monitoring, and audit workflows. Copy page Copy page Notification webhooks deliver Vast.ai notification events to an HTTPS endpoint you operate. They are grouped under the notification system because they use the same notification types and preferences as email notifications. Use webhooks when a notification should become an action: update your dashboard when an instance starts, pause automation when a low-balance event fires, or trigger cleanup when an instance is outbid. The same mechanics apply to host events — see Host Notifications . ​ How Webhooks Fit Into Notifications A webhook subscribes to one or more notification type keys. If you subscribe one webhook to both a client: and a host: variant of the same event, use a dedicated webhook per context to tell them apart reliably.
